Parse quoted Jinja variables in SQL text without recovery

```zig title="Zig"
const std = @import("std");
const tree_sitter_language_pack = @import("tree_sitter_language_pack");

pub fn main() !void {
    const _result_json = try tree_sitter_language_pack.process("CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE t(`a` string, `b` array<string>)\nPARTITIONED BY (`p` string)\nROW FORMAT SERDE 'org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.parquet.serde.ParquetHiveSerDe'\nSTORED AS INPUTFORMAT 'x' OUTPUTFORMAT 'y'\nLOCATION 's3://{{bucket}}/t/'\nTBLPROPERTIES ('k'='v');", "{\"language\":\"jinja2\"}");
    defer std.heap.c_allocator.free(_result_json);
    std.debug.print("{s}\n", .{_result_json});

}
```
